question: Padma Shri awardee, Shivnath Mishra is an exponent of Benaras Gharana and he plays _________ styles of Benaras Gayaki Ang.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Four**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Benaras Gharana and Gayaki Ang:**

 
 
• The Benaras Gharana is a prominent school of Hindustani classical music known for its distinctive style.
 
• "Gayaki Ang" refers to the style of instrumental music that emulates vocal music.
 
• Pandit Shivnath Mishra is particularly known for his ability to translate the nuances of Benaras Gayaki Ang onto the sitar.
 
• This involves incorporating vocal techniques like meend (glides), gamak (ornamentation), and taans (rapid melodic passages) into his instrumental performance.
 
• The Benaras Gharana is known for it's rich and diverse musical styles. It contains Khayal, Dhrupad, Thumari, Tappa, Chaiti, Hori, Kajari, and Dadra. Pandit Shivnath Mishra incorporates these vocal styles into his sitar playing.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Pandit Shivnath Mishra's Contributions:**

 
 
• He is a highly respected sitarist and a significant figure in preserving and promoting the Benaras Gharana tradition.
 
• He has performed extensively in India and abroad, showcasing the unique qualities of this musical style.
 
• He has also dedicated himself to teaching and passing on his knowledge to future generations.
 
• He formerly served as the Head of the Music Department at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University in Varanasi, demonstrating his commitment to music education.
 
• He has performed with many famous tabla players such as Padma Vibhushan Pandit Kishan Maharaj.
 
• He has also performed with Sarod players such as Aashish Khan.
 
• He is an "A" grade artist with All India Radio and TV.
 
• He has performed in many television broadcasts, both nationally and internationally.
 
• He has recorded many LP's and CD's.
 
• He has performed at many prestigious music festivals, including the Sangeet Natak Academy.
 
• He received the Padma Shri award in 2022.
 
• He received the UP Sangeet Natak Academy Award in 2004.
 
• He has performed in many different countries.
 
• He formed the musical group "Music of Benares".
 
• He has performed in many charity events.
 
• He has worked with many international Jazz musicians.
 
• He has been involved in many social movements, using his music to support them.
 
• He is an empaneled artist of the I.C.C.R (Indian Council for Cultural Relations).
